notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Frilled Deathspitter indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Frilled Deathspitter.
description:
Give Frilled Deathspitter indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Frilled Deathspitter, with all but 1 of that damage being prevented by Temple Altisaur.
Frilled Deathspitter, Ghyrson Starn, and Spark Double trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 2 damage to Frilled Deathspitter, with all but 1 of that damage being prevented by Temple Altisaur.
Spark Double and Frilled Deathspitter trigger.
Resolve the Frilled Deathspitter trigger, dealing 2 damage to target opponent.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, dealing 2 damage to Frilled Deathspitter, with all but 1 of that damage being prevented by Temple Altisaur.
Ghyrson Starn and Frilled Deathspitter trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
